chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated that from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
When you sit in the first two rak'ahs and recite the tashahhud, then stand up, say: “By the power of Allah and His strength I stand and I sit.”

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the two units of salat (prayer) being referred to here
key_terms.بِحَوْلِ اللَّهِ: by Allah’s power and enabling grace
key_terms.فَتَشَهَّدْتَ: you recited the tashahhud in the sitting position

ai.seo_question: What should be said when standing after the tashahhud in the first two rak'ahs of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a prescribed dhikr to be said when rising after the tashahhud in the first two rak'ahs of salat (prayer). It expresses reliance upon Allah’s power and strength in the movements of worship, showing the devotional etiquette attached to salat (prayer).
